an5.197:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave, vassassa antarāyā, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:1.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamo vassassa antarāyo yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, upari ākāse vāyodhātu pakuppati
an5.197:2.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rāhu asurindo pāṇinā udakaṃ sampaṭicchitvā mahāsamudde chaḍḍeti.
an5.197:3.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, vassavalāhakā devā pamattā honti.
an5.197:4.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave, catuttho vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, manussā adhammikā honti.
an5.197:5.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave, pañcamo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamati.
an5.197:5.3: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca vassassa antarāyā, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhuṃ na kamatīti.
